source_span: we think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold, so the long end is doing the work as term premium rebuilds
source_chain: 10Y breaks 4.40% therefore JPM reads it as a bear-steepener (front end anchored by a Fed on hold, long end doing the work as term premium rebuilds) therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp; invalidation: a hot core PCE Thursday validates the steepener, a soft print does NOT by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold
pulse_chain: 10Y breaks 4.40% therefore JPM reads it as markets pricing the next hike, front end leading and dragging the long end (a bear-flattener) therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp/stop 48bp; invalidation: a soft core PCE Thursday reverses the trade
why: The pulse inverts the mechanism (bear-flattener driven by hike-pricing vs. the note's bear-steepener driven by a Fed on hold/term-premium rebuild) and inverts the invalidation (soft PCE reverses it vs. the note's explicit soft-PCE-does-not-reverse-it).
